tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// byang phyogs gnod sbyin gyi gtor ma bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// byang du dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa// tsan+dan dmar po la sogs bya// me tog dmar sogs nye bar brgyan// sā lu'i 'bras chan sbrang rtsi zho// bdud rtsi lnga ldan snod gsum bzhag /thig le'am tshom bu nyi shu rtsa lnga dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bkod la/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas bzlas pa ci rigs pa byas te/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs nas/ skad cig ma'i ting nge 'dzin gyis dkyil 'khor dang mtshan ma rnams la gzhal yas khang dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi gtso bo dang*/ gtso mo nyi shu rtsa lngar bskyed la/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya dang*// sngags 'di yis ni dgug par bya// nor bu bzang dang gang ba bzang*// bde ba bzang dang rgyal ba bzang*// dga' ba'i phur bu phur chen po// phur bu bzang dang pad+ma'i gtsug /dung gi gtsug phud gar dang ni// gar chen dang ni 'bigs byed ma// gcod pa ma dang rdzogs byed ma// nor dang nor kun nor bzang mo// gzugs bzang rol dang rol chen mo// bzhad dang rtse dang rnam par spyod// dpal bzang dang ni gzugs mdzes mo// rdo rje dbang phyug bka' 'di yis// gnod sbyin gnod sbyin mo spyan 'dren// hūm̐ he ho ā kar+ṣa ya sa ma ya dī pe hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ yak+ṣa yak+ṣi ni ā gats+tsha ya ā gats+tsha ya zhes lan gsum gyis spyan drangs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim la/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis so so la gdan phul nas so so la mchod pa dang gtor ma dbul bar bya ste/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di// nor bu bzang la dbul bar bgyi// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ ba su bha drā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/

de bzhin du me tog dang*/ spos dang*/ dri dang*/ mar me dang*/ zhal zas dang*/ rol mo dang*/ gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan rnams la sbyar te dbul bar bya'o// rdo rje bcings bskor snying gar bzhag /sngags 'dis mnyes par byas la gtong*// oṃ dhā nā dhi pa ta ye ba ta li phruṃ swā hā/ zhes pa gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma dbul lo// de bzhin du/ gang ba bzang la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ pūr+ṇa bha drā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ bde ba bzang la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ su bha drā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ rgyal ba bzang la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ dza ya bha drā ya gṛh+ṇe da ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ dga' ba'i phur bu nyid la dbul// oṃ nan+da kī lā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ phur bu chen mo nyid la dbul// oṃ ma hā kī lī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ phur bu bzang la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ su kī lā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ pad+ma'i gtsug la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ pad+ma shi kha ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ dung gi gtsug phud nyid la dbul// oṃ shaṃ kha shi kha ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ gnod sbyin gar gyi gtso la dbul// oṃ ni ḍa gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ gnod sbyin gar chen nyid la dbul// oṃ ma hā ni ḍa gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ gnod sbyin 'bigs byed ma la dbul// oṃ dhin+da nī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ār+ghaṃ swā hā/ gnod sbyin gcod pa ma la dbul// oṃ ts+tshe da nā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ gnod sbyin rdzogs byed ma la dbul// oṃ pū ra ṇā ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ gnod sbyin nor la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ dhā nā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ nor kun la ni dbul bar bgyi// oṃ dha na dā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ nor bzang mo la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ su dhā nā yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ gnod sbyin gzugs bzang nyid la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ su rū pā yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/

gnod sbyin rol pa mo la dbul// oṃ ke lī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ gnod sbyin rol chen mo la dbul// oṃ ma hā ke lī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ gnod sbyin bzhad pa mo la dbul// oṃ ha si tā yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ gnod sbyin rtse ba mo la dbul// oṃ kṛ ti tā yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ rnam par bskyod la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ bik+ṣo ta bhā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ dpal bzang la ni dbul bar bgyi// oṃ su shrī yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ gzugs mdzes ma la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ rū pa kan+tī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ de ltar mchod pa dang gtor mas mnyes par byas nas/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ zhes pa rnams kyis phrin las bcol la/ so so'i rgyud bskul nas dngos grub bslang ba'i phyir rig sngags kyi bzlas pa bya ste/ oṃ bā su bha drā ya swā hā/ oṃ dā na a dhi pa ta ye swā hā/ oṃ pū r+ṇaṇa bha drā ya swā hā/ oṃ su bha drā ya swā hā/ oṃ dza ya bha drā ya swā hā/ oṃ nan+da kī lā ya swā hā/ oṃ ma hā kī lā ya swā hā/ oṃ su kī lā ya swā hā/ oṃ pad+ma shi kha ye swā hā/ oṃ shaṃ kha shi kha ye swā hā/ oṃ ni ḍā ya swā hā/ oṃ ma hā ni ḍā ya swā hā/ oṃ bhin+da nī ye swā hā/ oṃ ts+tshi da nī ye swā hā/ oṃ sū ra ṇī ye swā hā/ oṃ dhā nā ya swā hā/ oṃ dhā na dā ya swā hā/ oṃ su dhā nā yai swā hā/ oṃ sū rū pa ye swā hā/ oṃ ke lī ye swā hā/ oṃ ma hā ke lī ye swā hā/ oṃ hā si tā yai swā hā/ oṃ kṛ ḍi tā yai swā hā/ oṃ bi k+ṣo bhā ya swā hā/ oṃ su shri ye swā hā/ oṃ rū pa kan+tī ye swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags rnams re re la'ang brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs par bzla'o// slar yang mchod de dngos grub blangs nas bzod par gsol lo// oṃ ba su bha dra gats+tsha/

zhes kun la sbyar te gshegs su gsol lo// rim pa 'di nyid kyis thun gsum mam bzhi la sogs par gtong ngo*// yongs su rdzogs pa dang las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdu'o// shin tu bsdus te gtong bar 'dod na/ spyan 'dren pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ sngags kyis spyan drangs pa'i mthar/ oṃ dhā nā dhi pa ta ye la sogs pa'i sngags 'ba' zhig gis phul nas phrin las bcol la gshegs su gsol/ rgyas pa dang bsdus pa gnyis char gyis phrin las bcol pa'i mthar chos kyi sbyin pa dang*/ bden pa'i stobs brjod par bya'o// byang phyogs su bya ba gnod sbyin thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga rdzogs so// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
